# Markdown

> Rendered agent markdown (GFM) whose code fences compose Code, and diff fences compose CodeDiff.

This file matches the installed `markdown` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown.md`.

## Composition

### Rendered markdown

Pass the source in content. MarkdownRoot supplies tokens; MarkdownFlow owns block spacing.

```tsx
<Markdown>
  <MarkdownRoot>
    <MarkdownFlow>
      rendered prose and code fences
    </MarkdownFlow>
  </MarkdownRoot>
</Markdown>
```

### Custom prose

Compose MDX or Markdown parts inside MarkdownFlow, imported from ui/markdown-elements, which loads no optional peer: no Streamdown, Shiki, or virtualizer. Fenced code blocks and the full component map live in ui/markdown-components. MarkdownRoot carries the skin's markdown knobs; a part rendered outside it falls back to the neutral defaults. Re-value --cui-markdown-flow-gap and --cui-markdown-heading-gap on MarkdownRoot.

```tsx
<MarkdownRoot>
  <MarkdownFlow>
    consumer-rendered prose
  </MarkdownFlow>
</MarkdownRoot>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Markdown } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/markdown";

const SAMPLE = `## Deploy checklist

Here's the **plan** and a quick fix.

1. Run the migration
2. Restart the worker
3. Verify \`GET /health\`

A change to \`greet.ts\`:

\`\`\`diff
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@ export function greet()
 export function greet(name) {
-  return "Hello " + name;
+  return \`Hello \${name}!\`;
 }
\`\`\`

And the new helper:

\`\`\`ts
export const slugify = (s: string) => s.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, "-");
\`\`\`

### Before you ship

| Env | Status |
| --- | ------ |
| prod | ✅ |
| staging | ⏳ |
`;

export function PrimitiveMarkdownExample() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-2xl rounded-panel border bg-background p-4">
      <Markdown content={SAMPLE} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### markdown

- `--cui-markdown-foreground`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.9)`
- `--cui-markdown-blockquote-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-markdown-blockquote-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-markdown-inline-code-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.08)`
- `--cui-markdown-inline-code-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-markdown-inline-code-radius`: `var(--radius-sm)`
- `--cui-markdown-link-foreground`: `var(--primary-text)`
- `--cui-markdown-image-outline-color`: `var(--image-outline)`
- `--cui-markdown-table-cell-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-markdown-table-header-background`: `var(--muted)`
- `--cui-markdown-font-size`: `var(--text-body)`
- `--cui-markdown-line-height`: `var(--leading-relaxed)`
- `--cui-markdown-flow-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)`
- `--cui-markdown-heading-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 6)`
